main_text.p: re qui in recte constituenda vi-tæ summa,& inueniendo bono, vt putabant , summo , quæren-disque & explicandis mediis ad beatitatem ducentibus , suam omnem operam ponerent. Fuë-re qui ad singulas vitæ humanæ partes studium conferret suum, & quid cuique personæ , cuique ætati conueniret,queꝫ officia sin-gulorum , docere laborarent. Il-lam priorem veteres δογματικὴν[?], hac posteriorem ἀρχιτεκτονικὴν[?] phi-losophiam nuncuparūt.Fuit vero & tertium quoddam tractan-dæ morum disciplinæ genus , é re χαρακτηριστικὸν[?] ab iisdem illis nominatum. Pulcherrimam hac philosophandi viam,primus, vt videtur,senex facundissimi oris,

page.notes: The Greek words δογματικὴν, ἀρχιτεκτονικὴν and χαρακτηριστικὸν are set in a small, slightly blurred type; the letters are the likely reading but are marked [?]. The "é" in "é re" and the diaeresis in "Fuëre" are as printed. "conferrét" carries an acute accent as printed. Printing errors such as "nuncuparūt.Fuit" (missing space) are left as printed.
